title: Feature Request: India-Specific Pricing Plans (INR) for Claude & Claude Code
body:
## Summary
Request for Anthropic to introduce India-specific pricing plans in INR (Indian Rupees) for Claude Pro and Claude Code subscriptions, similar to what OpenAI (ChatGPT) and Google (Gemini) already offer.

## Problem
Currently, Claude subscriptions are only available in USD, which creates significant barriers for Indian users:

1. **Currency conversion costs**: Indians pay in INR but are charged in USD, incurring forex conversion fees (2-3%)
2. **GST on international transactions**: 18% GST is added to foreign currency transactions
3. **Effective cost is much higher**: Claude Pro ($20) becomes ~₹2,000+ after conversion and taxes
4. **No UPI support**: India's most popular payment method isn't supported
5. **No localized payment options**: No support for Indian payment gateways

## Competitor Comparison (India Pricing)

| Service | India Price (INR/month) | Special Offers |
|---------|-------------------------|----------------|
| ChatGPT Go | ₹399 | First year FREE for Indians |
| ChatGPT Plus | ₹1,999 | Localized pricing |
| Gemini AI Plus | ₹199 (intro) → ₹399 | 6-month intro pricing |
| Gemini AI Pro | ₹1,950 | Free 1 year for college students |
| **Claude Pro** | ~₹2,000+ (USD converted) | No localized pricing |

Both OpenAI and Google have recognized India as a major market and introduced:
- INR pricing
- UPI payment support
- Student/promotional offers
- Partnerships with Indian telcos (e.g., Jio)

## Proposed Solution

1. **Introduce INR pricing** for Claude Pro and Claude Max plans
2. **Add UPI as a payment option** (used by 300M+ Indians)
3. **Consider competitive pricing**: 
   - Claude Pro: ₹999-1,499/month (to compete with ChatGPT Go at ₹399)
   - Claude Max: ₹4,999-7,999/month
4. **Student discounts** for Indian college students
5. **Partner with Indian payment gateways** (Razorpay, Paytm, PhonePe)

## Why This Matters

- **India has 900M+ internet users** - one of the largest potential markets
- **Growing developer community** - India produces the most developers globally
- **AI adoption is accelerating** - but cost is a major barrier
- **Competitors are winning** - ChatGPT and Gemini are capturing the Indian market with localized pricing
- **Claude Code specifically** - developers need affordable access to use Claude Code for their work

## Current Pain Points (User Perspective)

> "To use Claude Code we need a subscription and if it's in dollars and including GST it's very expensive for Indians who make money in INR unless provided by a corporate."

This sentiment is common among Indian developers and professionals who want to use Claude but find the pricing prohibitive compared to alternatives.

## Business Case

- India's AI market is projected to reach $17B by 2027
- Localized pricing typically increases adoption 3-5x in emerging markets
- First-mover advantage in localized pricing builds brand loyalty
- Enterprise adoption in India often starts with individual developers

## Additional Context

Countries like Brazil, Indonesia, and other emerging markets would also benefit from similar localized pricing strategies.

- [Google AI Plus India Pricing](https://techcrunch.com/2025/12/10/google-launches-sub-5-ai-plus-plan-in-india-to-compete-with-chatgpt-go/)
